headline: HOU @ TOR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is HOU 4.42 at TOR 4.41, with a projected total of 8.84. Movement read: Both offenses moved up (HOU +0.16, TOR +0.31), so the movement is more about a higher-scoring game environment than a stronger side. The projected total climbed +0.47, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +23.8%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Peter Lambert has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Yordan Alvarez, George Springer, Jeremy Peña, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Christian Vázquez, Brice Matthews because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
